matchstick.title: Balance by numeric difference and single‑stick transformation
matchstick.principle: Compute the integer values of both sides, find the numeric difference, and then search for a single‑stick move that can adjust the values to balance the equation.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever the equation is false, start by calculating the numeric values of each side to determine the required adjustment.
matchstick.example: Failing to compute the numeric difference and directly guessing a stick move without checking the numeric impact.

matchstick.title: Convert V to X to add 5
matchstick.principle: If the numeric imbalance is exactly 5 and a V appears, relocate one of V’s diagonal sticks to turn the V into an X, increasing its value by 5.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 5 and a V is present in the expression.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from a V but not forming an X, leaving an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Swap I and V in IV to make VI (adds 2)
matchstick.principle: When the imbalance is exactly 2 and the pattern IV appears, move the vertical stick of the I onto the V to turn IV into VI, increasing the value by 2.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation is off by 2 and the numeral IV is present.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from IV but not forming VI, resulting in an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Change + to - and add I
matchstick.principle: If a plus sign is present and the numeric imbalance can be fixed by decreasing the right‑hand side, move the vertical stick from the plus sign to turn it into a minus sign and use that stick to add an I to a numeral, adjusting the values appropriately.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation contains a '+' and the RHS is too large, consider converting '+' to '-' and adding the removed stick as an I.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from '+' but not adding it as an I, leaving the operator unchanged and the equation still false.

matchstick.title: Transfer I stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: When the equation is off by 1 and there are isolated I’s, relocate a vertical stick from one I to another numeral, increasing one value by 1 and decreasing the other by 1 to achieve balance.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the numeric difference is exactly 1 and moving a stick between I's can keep both numerals valid.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from an I and leaving the source numeral empty, creating an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Preserve equality sign; never move its sticks
matchstick.principle: Never move any sticks from the '=' sign; moving them would break the equality operator and invalidate the puzzle.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Always, before considering any stick moves, keep the equality sign unchanged.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from the equality sign, resulting in an invalid '='.

matchstick.title: Change - to = by adding a horizontal stick from a numeral
matchstick.principle: If the equation contains a minus sign and the numeric imbalance is large, consider moving a stick (e.g., the vertical stick from an I) to the minus sign, rotating it to horizontal to turn '-' into '=', creating a chain equality that can balance the equation.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a '-' is present and you can spare a stick from a numeral without invalidating it, and converting '-' to '=' yields a valid chain equality that resolves the numeric mismatch.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from a numeral to the minus sign but not rotating it, leaving the operator unchanged and the equation still false.

matchstick.description: Moving a stick from the equality sign
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may treat the equality sign as a source of sticks because it contains matchsticks, but moving them breaks the equality operator.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Never consider any stick from the '=' sign as a candidate for relocation; keep the equality sign unchanged.

matchstick.description: Providing an incomplete equation after moving a stick
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may forget to place the moved stick or may truncate the output, resulting in a missing left side, operator, or right side.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Ensure the final answer contains a complete equation with both sides and an equality sign, and that the moved stick is placed to form a valid numeral or operator.
